title: The Verdict of Little Hawley Revisited
author: Elodie Ashgrove
blurb: Jonah Iversen, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
